title: 同行工具站景观与页面质量抽样
scope: 补充 LDDGO 目录核对之外的国内外工具站样本，记录目录规模、SEO 页面结构、移动端布局和少量真实交互证据。数量为页面/卡片口径，不能相加成独立能力总数。

evidence_levels.official_directory: 官方目录或首页卡片，证明入口/公开声明存在，未证明正确性
evidence_levels.official_page_runtime_snapshot: Playwright 读取官方页面 DOM、标题、meta、控件和布局指标
evidence_levels.same_input_runtime: 在官方工具页输入固定样本并读取页面输出，仍只代表该样本
evidence_levels.blocked_or_empty: 官方请求触发反爬、无内容或无法取得足够证据

same_input_evidence.independent_check: SHA-256, SHA-224 and RIPEMD-160 values match standard known vectors for abc.

cross_site_observations.observation: Observed directory/card scale exceeds 1,200 route/card records across LDDGO, IT-Tools, PDF24, Toolbox365 and 10015 before deduplication.
cross_site_observations.interpretation: This is evidence of a large comparison universe, not 1,200 independent product requirements. Canonical slug matching and shared-engine grouping are required.

cross_site_observations.observation: Large sites generally expose a plain title and meta description; headings and JSON-LD vary. PDF24 and 10015 have explicit category/directory headings; IT-Tools has no h1 in the runtime DOM snapshot; BeJSON and JSON.cn expose many links but no h1 in the captured homepage DOM.
cross_site_observations.interpretation: Zoyku should measure one page contract per tool (title, h1, description, canonical, hreflang, visible task content, structured data) rather than copy any site's aggregate markup.

cross_site_observations.observation: At 390px, BeJSON's document width was 914px and DevToys' was 490px; other sampled home/directory pages had no page-level horizontal overflow.
cross_site_observations.interpretation: The two overflow cases require element-level reproduction before labeling a competitor defect; they are useful regression fixtures for Zoyku mobile QA.

cross_site_observations.observation: Playwright snapshots exposed named controls on IT-Tools and form controls on PDF24/regex101, but no automated WCAG score was inferred from DOM counts.
cross_site_observations.interpretation: Run axe plus keyboard and screen-reader checks on representative tool pages. Link counts, focusable counts and button counts are diagnostics, not compliance scores.

limitations: This report is an evidence ledger, not a ranking of competitors.
Directory/card counts use each site's current public DOM and may change without notice.
Official descriptions and schema presence do not prove tool correctness, privacy, speed, accessibility or search performance.
Only one competitor tool had a fixed input and independent vector check in this pass; other same-input comparisons remain open.
No search-volume, Search Console, traffic, revenue, conversion or backlink dataset was used.
Blocked/empty pages are recorded as unavailable rather than filled with search snippets or assumptions.
next_research_batch: Persist the 420-row LDDGO catalog and canonicalize it against Zoyku's 211 registry tools.
Extract route-level cards from PDF24, Toolbox365 and 10015 into separate deduplicated tables.
Select 20 high-overlap tools for paired same-input runs, with saved inputs/outputs and independent vectors.
Repeat mobile/keyboard/axe snapshots on matched tool pages instead of homepages only.
Add source dates and change detection so counts and metadata are not silently reused as current facts.
